sources.name: CBN Guide to Charges by Banks, Other Financial and Non-Bank Financial Institutions (effective 1 January 2020)
Flutterwave Help Centre: Pricing for receiving payments

entries.subject: interbank_transfer_fee
entries.display: N10 for electronic funds transfers below N5,000
entries.quote: 10.2 Electronic Funds Transfer:  Below N5,000 – N10 N5,001 - N50,000 – N25 Above N50,000 – N50
entries.notes: Agrees with Stanbic IBTC 2026 Pricing Guide (N10 below N5,000) and Paystack transfer pricing (NGN 10 per transfer at or below N5,000).

entries.subject: interbank_transfer_fee
entries.display: N25 for electronic funds transfers of N5,001 to N50,000
entries.quote: N5,001 to N50,000 - N25 plus VAT.
entries.notes: Bank tariff restating the CBN 2020 Guide band; CBN Guide s.10.2 states N25 for N5,001-N50,000. Stanbic charges N25 plus VAT.

entries.subject: interbank_transfer_fee
entries.display: N50 for electronic funds transfers above N50,000
entries.notes: Same band appears in Stanbic IBTC 2026 Pricing Guide as 'Above N50,000 - N50 plus VAT' and in Paystack transfer pricing.

entries.subject: atm_withdrawal_fee_not_on_us
entries.display: N35 per withdrawal from another bank's ATM after the third withdrawal in a month
entries.quote: N35 after the third withdrawal within the same month

entries.subject: merchant_service_commission
entries.display: 0.50% merchant service commission on card transactions
entries.quote: 0.50% of transaction value but not more than N1,000

entries.subject: merchant_service_commission_cap
entries.display: Merchant service commission capped at N1,000 per transaction
entries.quote: 0.50% of transaction value but not more than N1,000
entries.notes: A 2026 exposure draft of a revised Guide would raise the cap to N10,000; not in force at capture.

entries.subject: card_transaction_fee_local
entries.display: Paystack charges 1.5% plus NGN 100 on local transactions
entries.notes: Paystack pricing page is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date.

entries.subject: card_transaction_fee_cap
entries.display: Paystack local transaction fees are capped at N2,000
entries.quote: Local transactions fees are capped at ₦2000, meaning that's the absolute maximum you'll ever pay in fees per transaction
entries.notes: Page undated; effective_from is the capture date.

entries.subject: card_transaction_fee_international
entries.display: Paystack charges 3.9% plus NGN 100 on international transactions
entries.notes: Page undated; effective_from is the capture date.

entries.subject: card_transaction_fee_local
entries.display: Flutterwave charges Nigerian merchants 2.0% on local cards (1.4% transaction fee + 0.6% platform fee)
entries.notes: Article marked 'Updated 16 months ago' at capture; effective_from is the capture date.

entries.subject: free_transfers_per_month
entries.display: Kuda gives 25 free transfers to other banks each month
entries.quote: Get unlimited free Kuda to Kuda transfers, and 25 free transfers to any other bank, every month.
entries.notes: Page undated; effective_from is the capture date.

entries.subject: interbank_transfer_fee
entries.display: Kuda charges N10 per transfer to other banks after the 25 free monthly transfers
entries.quote: For those not on Kuda you can transfer 25 times for free, and after that we charge a low fee of ₦10 per transfer.
entries.notes: Kuda FAQs add that 7.5% VAT applies to the N10 fee only.

entries.subject: card_transaction_fee_local
entries.display: OPay Checkout charges 1.5% per local transaction, capped at N2,000
entries.quote: per local transaction capped at N2000
entries.notes: Page undated; effective_from is the capture date.

notes: Tariffs are quoted as the CBN ceiling plus the platform's own published rate. Bank tariffs add VAT on top of the CBN figures. Undated platform pricing pages use the corpus capture date as effective_from.
